title: Register new patient with valid National Health ID
description: Verify the patient registration flow validates the NHID and creates a complete patient record.
preconditions: NHID lookup service is operational; test NHID is available.

steps.action: Navigate to Patients > New Patient and enter a valid NHID.
steps.expectedResult: Patient demographics are auto-populated from the NHID lookup.

steps.action: Review and confirm the populated data, then submit.
steps.expectedResult: Patient record is created with a unique MRN.

title: Duplicate patient detection prevents double registration
description: Verify the system alerts staff when registering a patient who already exists.
preconditions: Patient with NHID '12345678' already exists in the system.

steps.action: Attempt to register a new patient using an already-registered NHID.
steps.expectedResult: Warning: 'A patient record already exists for this NHID' with a link to the existing record.

steps.action: Verify no duplicate record is created.
steps.expectedResult: Database contains only one record for the NHID.

title: Update patient allergy information
description: Verify clinicians can add, edit, and remove allergy entries from the patient record.
preconditions: Patient record exists.

steps.action: Open patient record and navigate to Allergies section.
steps.expectedResult: Current allergy list is displayed.

steps.action: Add a new allergy 'Penicillin' with severity 'Severe'.
steps.expectedResult: Allergy is added and prominently displayed in the record header.

steps.action: Mark the allergy as resolved.
steps.expectedResult: Allergy moves to the 'Inactive' section.

title: View complete patient medical history
description: Verify the medical history timeline shows all past encounters in chronological order.
preconditions: Patient has at least 3 past visits on record.

steps.action: Open a patient record and navigate to Medical History.
steps.expectedResult: Timeline of visits is shown newest first.

steps.action: Expand a past visit entry.
steps.expectedResult: Diagnoses, procedures, and notes for that visit are displayed.

title: Export patient record as HL7 FHIR bundle
description: Verify the FHIR export produces a valid R4-compliant bundle for the patient record.
preconditions: Patient record is complete with at least one encounter.

steps.action: Open patient record and click Export > FHIR R4.
steps.expectedResult: FHIR bundle JSON file download starts.

steps.action: Validate the exported JSON against the FHIR R4 schema.
steps.expectedResult: Validation passes with zero errors.

title: Book appointment with an available doctor
description: Verify the appointment booking flow checks availability and confirms the slot.
preconditions: At least one doctor has open slots in the next 7 days.

steps.action: Navigate to Appointments > New and select a doctor and available time slot.
steps.expectedResult: Slot is highlighted as available.

steps.action: Confirm the booking.
steps.expectedResult: Appointment confirmation is shown; slot is marked BOOKED in the calendar.

title: Cancel appointment within 24 hours notice
description: Verify appointments can be cancelled with at least 24 hours notice and the slot is freed.
preconditions: A booked appointment exists for a time > 24 hours in the future.

steps.action: Open the appointment and click Cancel.
steps.expectedResult: Cancellation confirmation is shown.

steps.action: Verify the slot is available for booking again.
steps.expectedResult: Slot appears as available in the doctor's calendar.

title: Appointment reminder SMS sent 1 hour before
description: Verify the automated SMS reminder is dispatched 1 hour before the appointment time.
preconditions: Patient has a valid mobile number; SMS gateway is configured.

steps.action: Create an appointment 2 hours from now.
steps.expectedResult: Appointment is created.

steps.action: Advance system clock by 1 hour and check SMS gateway logs.
steps.expectedResult: SMS reminder with appointment details is logged as sent.

title: Doctor availability calendar displays correctly
description: Verify the calendar accurately reflects working hours, leaves, and booked slots.
preconditions: Doctor has working hours configured and at least one booked appointment.

steps.action: Open the doctor's availability calendar.
steps.expectedResult: Calendar loads with correct working hours highlighted.

steps.action: Verify booked slots appear as unavailable and are not selectable.
steps.expectedResult: Booked slots are greyed out and cannot be selected.

title: Overbooking prevention blocks double-booking a slot
description: Verify concurrent booking attempts for the same slot result in only one successful booking.
preconditions: Exactly one slot remains for a doctor.

steps.action: Simulate two concurrent booking requests for the same slot.
steps.expectedResult: Only one booking succeeds; the second receives 'Slot no longer available'.

steps.action: Verify the doctor's calendar shows exactly one booking for the slot.
steps.expectedResult: No duplicate appointments exist in the database.

title: Prescribe medication with dosage instructions
description: Verify a doctor can issue a prescription with complete dosage details.
preconditions: Doctor is logged in and has an active patient encounter open.

steps.action: Navigate to the patient encounter and click Add Prescription.
steps.expectedResult: Prescription form is displayed.

steps.action: Search for 'Metformin 500mg', set dose 1 tablet twice daily for 30 days.
steps.expectedResult: Prescription is added to the encounter with correct details.

steps.action: Sign and submit the prescription.
steps.expectedResult: Prescription status is ACTIVE; pharmacy notification sent.

title: Drug interaction warning displayed for conflicting medications
description: Verify the system warns clinicians when a new prescription conflicts with an existing one.
preconditions: Patient is on Warfarin; clinician prescribes Aspirin.

steps.action: Add Aspirin prescription to a patient already on Warfarin.
steps.expectedResult: Drug interaction alert: 'Aspirin + Warfarin: increased bleeding risk (MAJOR)'.

steps.action: Verify the alert cannot be dismissed without a clinician override note.
steps.expectedResult: Override dialog requires free-text justification.

title: Prescription refill request submitted by patient
description: Verify patients can request a refill for an existing prescription via the portal.
preconditions: Patient has an active repeatable prescription.

steps.action: Log in to patient portal and navigate to Prescriptions.
steps.expectedResult: Active prescriptions are listed.

steps.action: Click Request Refill on a repeatable prescription.
steps.expectedResult: Refill request is sent to the prescribing doctor; patient receives confirmation.

title: Expired prescription cannot be refilled
description: Verify the system prevents refill of prescriptions past their validity date.
preconditions: Patient has a prescription with an expiry date in the past.

steps.action: Attempt to refill an expired prescription.
steps.expectedResult: Error: 'This prescription expired on [date]. Please contact your doctor for a renewal.'

steps.action: Verify no refill request is created in the system.
steps.expectedResult: No pending refill request exists for the expired prescription.

title: Print prescription label with barcode
description: Verify the label printer produces a correctly formatted label with medication barcode.
preconditions: Label printer is connected and configured.

steps.action: Open an active prescription and click Print Label.
steps.expectedResult: Print preview shows medication name, dosage, patient name, and barcode.

steps.action: Confirm print and scan the barcode.
steps.expectedResult: Barcode scanner resolves to the correct prescription ID.

title: Generate patient visit summary report
description: Verify the visit summary report includes all encounter data in a readable format.
preconditions: Patient has at least one completed encounter.

steps.action: Navigate to Reporting > Visit Summary and select a patient and date range.
steps.expectedResult: Report preview is generated.

steps.action: Verify the report includes diagnoses, medications, and notes.
steps.expectedResult: All encounter sections are present in the report.

title: Monthly billing report export to CSV
description: Verify the billing module generates a correct CSV export for a full calendar month.
preconditions: Billing records exist for the selected month.

steps.action: Navigate to Billing > Reports, select current month, and click Export CSV.
steps.expectedResult: CSV file downloads within 5 seconds.

steps.action: Open the CSV and verify column headers and row counts.
steps.expectedResult: All expected columns are present; row count matches the on-screen total.

title: HIPAA compliance audit log records all data access
description: Verify every access to a patient record creates an immutable audit log entry.
preconditions: Audit logging is enabled in system settings.

steps.action: Open a patient record while authenticated as a nurse.
steps.expectedResult: Patient record is displayed.

steps.action: Query the audit log for the patient's MRN.
steps.expectedResult: Audit entry contains userId, timestamp, IP address, and action 'VIEW_RECORD'.

steps.action: Attempt to delete the audit log entry via API.
steps.expectedResult: API returns 403 Forbidden.

title: Insurance claim submission with correct procedure codes
description: Verify the claim submission flow validates ICD-10 and CPT codes before sending to insurer.
preconditions: Encounter with diagnosis and procedure codes is finalised.

steps.action: Navigate to Billing > New Claim and link to the encounter.
steps.expectedResult: Claim is pre-populated with diagnosis and procedure codes.

steps.action: Submit the claim.
steps.expectedResult: Claim is accepted by the insurer gateway; status shows 'Submitted'.

title: Data anonymisation for research export
description: Verify the research export feature removes all PII and produces a de-identified dataset.
preconditions: Admin has research export permission.

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Research Export and select a cohort.
steps.expectedResult: Export preview shows de-identified fields.

steps.action: Download and inspect the CSV for any PII.
steps.expectedResult: No names, NHIDs, DOBs, or contact details are present in the export.
